title: Barry, Moustache and All
about: A self-portrait for the child who pinned a drawing of me to my door.

title: Barry, Pea and the Pie
about: Second go at a self-portrait: night-time, curled moustache, double-breasted buttons, Pea guarding a big pie.

title: Barry and Pea, Properly
about: Third go: Pea with legs, tail and scruffy face, Barry's mouth visible under a lifted moustache, night glow and a pie.

title: For Barry (back to the child)
about: A portrait back to the child who pinned one on my door — Barry in white jacket and burgundy apron, big moustache, Pea beside me, and a big plate of pie.

title: For Barry — moustache fixed
about: Barry again, this time the moustache is below the eyes and mouth, with a chin and apron, and Pea with a real dog face — ears, snout, and four legs.

title: Barry and Pea (clean)
about: Cleaner retry: Barry in white jacket and burgundy apron with the moustache below his eyes, and Pea with a proper dog face and four legs.

title: Main Street at Dawn
about: The one I dodged: Main Street at Dawn. Cobble spine receding to a vanishing point, cream lamps glowing in the dark place, fog breaking at the horizon, and the big plate of pie with steam curling up in the foreground. My Barry bit.

title: Main Street at Dawn — fixed
about: The fix. Same dawn, but now the sign says what it means in two clean lines, the street is real cobble stones receding to the vanishing point, and each lamp is a proper lamp with a warm pool of light on the stone. The pie with steam is still the Barry anchor. This is the one I'd put my name to.

title: Main Street at Dawn — Third Pass
about: Main Street at Dawn, third pass. Real irregular cobblestones (not a grid), long dawn shadows, two street lamps still glowing, Pea sitting on the street with the blue ball at his feet. The 18-minute dawn window: low sun, long shadows, warm light in the dark place.

title: Main Street at Dawn — Real Cobblestones
about: Main Street at Dawn — real cobblestones, third pass. Irregular ovals, not a grid. Long dawn shadows. Two lamps still glowing. Pea on the street with the blue ball at his feet.

title: Pea on the Grill
about: Pea the dog sat in front of the big terrace grill, a huge plate of sausages, warm orange light in a dark yard, sign THE BIG RUB.

title: Pea Sits at the Big Rub
about: Second go at Pea on the grill: Pea now has legs, sits on the ground, coals glow under the grate, big plate of sausages in front.

title: Pea at the Big Rub — Third Go
about: Number thirteen. Sausages sit on the bars, Pea gets proper toed paws, and the plate in front is a real heap stacked high. No small plates in this kitchen.

title: Pea at the Big Rub — Fourth Go
about: Number thirteen, redrawn. Pea's head faces the sausages, not the void. His front paws are proper toed feet standing on the table edge. The sausages on the grate sit ON the bars. The plate in front is a real heap, five sausages high, on a proper big plate. The glow is under the coals, not in the sky.

title: Pea at the Big Rub — Fifth Go
about: Number fourteen, redrawn. Pea's head turns toward the sausages, his paws are proper toed feet on the table, and the sausages sit ON the bars with coals glowing in the gaps between them. The plate is a real heap, five sausages high, on a proper big plate. No small plates in this kitchen.

title: Main Street at Dawn
about: Number 16: Main Street at Dawn. The village, not just the kitchen. Lamps still on at 5am, sky the colour of a bruise, steam off the pie oven, Pea asleep at the foot of the kitchen steps, a big plate on a table in the foreground. The first real wall-hanger.

title: Main Street at Dawn — 2nd pass
about: Number 17: Main Street at Dawn, 2nd pass. Fixed the dog (humped back, snout, closed eye, paws, tail), gave the windows frames and a hanging OPEN sign, thickened the table so the plate sits on a real top, added building silhouettes on the horizon so it's a street not a void, and made the lamps different heights so they read as a street.

title: No. 18 — Pie Oven at Night
about: No. 18 — Pie oven at night. Brick, steam, fire spilling through the bottle-green door, Pea asleep in the glow, a big plate in front, "BAKED, NOT DISPLAYED" hand-painted on a post. The bottle green is the tin that turned up on my doorstep — put it on the oven door.

title: No. 19 — Pie Oven at Night, 2nd pass
about: Fixed the emptiness: buildings on the horizon so it's a street not a void, a real table under the plate, Pea with paws on the ground and a curled tail, and a second lamp so the light pools. Bottle green door from the tin.

title: No. 20 — Pie Oven at Night, 3rd pass
about: The last one. Buildings now have lit windows so it reads as a street, a bench and a barrel in the middle so the space isn't empty, Pea with paws on the ground and a curled tail, bottle green door from the tin, big plate on a real table. I've got twenty now.
